detail.longDescription: I am trying to determine the cost and consumption of GitHub Copilot Enterprise licenses for my organization. As a GitHub Organization Administrator , I do not have Enterprise Admin privileges. However, I can access the Enterprise settings, possibly because I administer multiple GitHub Enterprise Cloud organizations or have been granted a limited Enterprise-level role. When I navigate to the Enterprise settings and review the Billing & Licensing section, I do not see any information related to: GitHub Copilot Enterprise licensing costs AI/LLM credit consumption Remaining credits or usage quotas Per-user Copilot usage details My goal is to understand how GitHub Copilot Enterprise usage is billed and how AI model consumption is tracked within our GitHub Enterprise environment. For example, in VS Code , users can hover over the GitHub Copilot status indicator and see AI credit usage information. This suggests that some form of usage tracking exists. However, I have been unable to locate equivalent reporting or administrative visibility within GitHub Enterprise. Specifically, I would like to know: How many AI credits or premium requests are allocated to a GitHub Copilot Enterprise user? Where can Organization Administrators or Enterprise Administrators view Copilot consumption and associated costs? How is AI model usage (such as GPT, Claude, Gemini, or other approved Copilot Chat models) measured and billed? Are there enterprise-level limits, budgets, quotas, or usage reports available? What mechanisms are available to monitor usage and proactively notify developers if consumption approaches organizational limits or budget thresholds? Any guidance on the appropriate GitHub Enterprise dashboards, reports, permissions, or APIs that provide this information would be appreciated.
